author: Brandjuh
name: KillCounter
short: Chat kills: the last word before a channel goes quiet scores a point.
description: Chat kills: when a channel goes quiet after someone speaks, the last word scores a point. Includes a leaderboard.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-member chat kill counts and the timestamp of each member's last kill. Users can request deletion of their data through Red's data deletion API.
